fusions.name: Thorn Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a thorn that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooting Pounce
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Basking
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Roots
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. You also regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
